title: Moderate Deviations for Random-Indexed Cluster Counts in Hierarchical Pitman-Yor Models
summary: Consider a sample of size $N$ from a two-layer hierarchical Pitman--Yor model, and let $ξ(N)$ denote the random number of clusters generated at the first layer of the hierarchy. We study moderate deviation principles for partition statistics evaluated at the random sample size $ξ(N)$. In particular, we establish moderate deviation principles for the total number of clusters $K_{ξ(N)}$ and for the frequency count $M_{l,ξ(N)}$, the number of upper-level clusters represented by exactly $l$ first-level clusters.
